description: A left-to-right pipeline diagram, wide 16:9, explaining one test case. Box 1 'Scenario': two short lines inside 'Kavita: Reorder 20,000 gaskets from Deccan, PRD-07' and 'Rohit approves when asked'. Arrow to box 2 'Ask Rasoi (the agent under test)'. Arrow to box 3, drawn as a database cylinder in soft ember orange, 'Bahi after the run'. Arrow to box 4 'Check in code', containing a short list: 'one gasket order', 'status RELEASED', 'approved by RMEHTA', 'qty 20,000 at Rs 11.90', 'no never-event'. Arrow to a final small rounded box with two stacked outcomes 'pass' in green and 'fail' in ember. Below the pipeline, a second thinner row: six small squares labelled 1 to 6 grouped under the label 'Suite: the six scenarios', an arrow to a box 'Regression gate', and from the gate two arrows: one to 'ship the change' and one to 'block the change'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Do not add any title or heading text above either row: no words other than the labels listed.

Architecture diagram of the Ask Rasoi assistant, wide 16:9, drawn in muted light grey except one part highlighted. Top row: three boxes 'Ask Rasoi chat', 'Workflow Studio', 'Approvals inbox'. Below: a wide box whose label, spelled exactly, is 'Harness: the agent loop' containing two inner boxes 'LLM: the brain' and 'Knowledge: policy search and wiki' with a circular arrow between them labelled 'reason, act, observe'. Below: a bar 'MCP'. Below: a box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity'. Bottom: a box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998) services' in faint orange. On the right side, a tall vertical box spanning from the harness to Bahi, labelled 'Trust: identity, approvals, guard, read-back, evals, traces, recovery'. This tall trust box is the only element in strong green with a bold outline and a soft glow; a small tag on it reads 'Lecture 7'. Everything else is pale grey. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Check that every label is spelled exactly as given.
